sections.heading: Chief Apostle is coming to America!
sections.text:
Chief Apostle Prophet Osman N. Weaver is coming to America in 2027, with major cities including New York, Orlando, Miami, Atlanta, Chicago, Houston, Dallas, Los Angeles, Philadelphia, Washington D.C., Tampa, Jacksonville and more.

Would you like to partner with us? Nothing is too small. Sponsor line (only for sponsors): **407-801-2338**. Please allow 24–72 hours for a response.
